name: Scattered Stars consumers still hit and pay mana on a corpse (#4224)
contract: Scattered Stars 804378 (Spell.dbc AttributesEx3 0x40140080 has SPELL_ATTR3_ALLOW_AURA_WHILE_DEAD 0x100000, so SpellInfo::IsDeathPersistent keeps the stacks through Unit::RemoveAllAurasOnDeath; Ex2 0x400005 has SPELL_ATTR2_ALLOW_DEAD_TARGET 0x1). The consumer 804716 (periodic dummy, amplitude 500, Ex3 0x40100000 death persistent, Ex2 0x5), 572315 (Ex2 0x5) and the hit helper 804995 (Ex2 0x80005) carry the same dead-target flag; the record is authored for corpses. Before the fix StartConsume() cast 804716 through Cast(), which requires target->IsAlive(), and Consume() called IsValidAttackTarget(target) without the spell, which rejects a dead target (Unit.cpp _IsValidAttackTarget), so a Lance that killed its target consumed nothing and paid no mana. Both fixtures are the same race/class/level: each applies one star with Fan of Knives 680703, sets mana to 0, and casts Lunar Lance 801132 (cost 0, trigger 572315 -> StartConsume). The control's target is healthy (the consume path that always worked); the test's target has 1 health so the Lance kills it and the consumer must run on the corpse. The consume returns 8% of maximum mana, so the test fixture's mana over the control's must be about 1.0; without the fix the corpse case returns only regeneration (near 0). The assertion demands at least 0.8. Known limit: the creature corpse must still exist about a second after death; it should, corpses last minutes.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control consumes its star on a living target
Mana returned by a living target
Leave the test target one hit from death
Test Lance kills its target while it holds a star
The corpse still pays the consume mana
